reasons: Cited text (8.2/8.3) matches the preferred position on every parameter: successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewal terms, Customer-only opt-out on thirty days' notice, a Vendor reminder sixty days before renewal, and renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent.
Reminder-failure clause extending Customer's opt-out deadline is more favourable than the playbook requires; no walk-away trigger (no >90-day window, no automatic multi-year renewal) is present.
Deterministic check confirms notice window = 30 days, within the preferred ≤30-day threshold.
Consistent with a compliant claim, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed; original paragraphs are left unchanged, so there is no directional or over-editing risk.

Rationale correctly distinguishes the three-year master agreement term in 8.1 from an automatic multi-year renewal and notes 7.1 fixes Fees during the initial term, so no separate escalator is missed.
